atoms.text: The Mayans were an ancient civilisation that existed in present-day Mexico and Guatemala. The Mayan people existed for a long time, from about 1800 B.C. until 900 A.D. The Mayans were very advanced for their time and are known for their farming methods, their calendar and astronomy. They built many pyramids that you can still visit today. It is important to remember history and the people who came before us.

atoms.a: Where in the world did the Mayans live?

b: It is important because the Mayans are our neighbours.
